def clean_text_for_model(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or text is None:
        return " "
    if isinstance(text, str):

        if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
            text = text[1:-1]
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"http\S+|www\S+|https\S+", "", text)
        text = re.sub(r"@\w+", " ", text)
        text = re.sub(r"#\w+", " ", text)
    return str(text).strip()

class LexiconPhraser:
    def __init__(self, lexicon, phrases):
        self.lexicon_items = list(lexicon.items())
        self.keys = [k for k, v in self.lexicon_items]
        self.weights = [v for k, v in self.lexicon_items]
        self.phrases = list(phrases)
        self.fixed_len = len(self.keys) + len(self.phrases)
        self.phrase_idx_offset = len(self.keys)

    def score_text(self, text):
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = str(text).lower()
        else:
            text = text.lower()
        if not text.strip():
            return np.zeros(self.fixed_len)

        scores = np.zeros(self.fixed_len)

        for i, (word, weight) in enumerate(self.lexicon_items):
            normal_count = text.count(word)
            upper_count = text.count(word.upper())
            mixed_count = text.count(word.capitalize())
            total_score = (
                normal_count * weight
                + upper_count * weight * 2
                + mixed_count * weight * 1.5
            )
            scores[i] = total_score

        for i, phrase in enumerate(self.phrases):
            count = text.count(phrase)
            scores[self.phrase_idx_offset + i] = count * 0.8

        return scores

# Proximity-based interaction features
def extract_proximity_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = str(text)
        if not text.strip():
            features.append([0.0] * 6)
            continue

        words = text.lower().split()
        n_words = len(words)
        if n_words < 2:
            features.append([0.0] * 6)
            continue

        lexicon_words = set(class_lexicon.keys())
        lex_positions = [i for i, w in enumerate(words) if w in lexicon_words]

        if len(lex_positions) < 2:
            features.append([0.0] * 6)
            continue

        distances = np.array(
            [j - i for i in lex_positions for j in lex_positions if j > i]
        )
        max_dist = max(distances) if len(distances) > 0 else 0.0
        avg_dist = np.mean(distances) if len(distances) > 0 else 0.0
        pairs_within_2 = sum(1 for d in distances if d <= 2)
        pairs_within_5 = sum(1 for d in distances if d <= 5)
        total_pairs = n_words * (n_words - 1) / 2
        clustering_ratio = pairs_within_2 / max(total_pairs, 1)
        lex_density = len(lex_positions) / max(n_words, 1)

        features.append(
            [
                max_dist,
                avg_dist,
                pairs_within_2,
                pairs_within_5,
                clustering_ratio,
                lex_density,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)

# Sentence-level features - FIXED: removed duplicate target_per_sent
def extract_sentence_features(texts):
    features = []
    pronouns = ["you", "your", "yours", "you're", "yall"]
    strong_words = [
        "must",
        "will",
        "should",
        "have",
        "can",
        "won't",
        "cant",
        "dont",
        "doesnt",
    ]

    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = str(text)
        if not text.strip():
            features.append([0.0] * 17)
            continue

        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        n_sentences = max(len(sentences), 1)

        you_count = sum(text.lower().count(p) for p in pronouns)
        imperative_count = sum(
            1
            for sent in sentences
            if any(
                imp in sent.lower()
                for imp in [
                    "stop",
                    "come",
                    "go",
                    "dont",
                    "must",
                    "will",
                    "should",
                    "let",
                    "get",
                    "take",
                    "make",
                ]
            )
        )
        question_sentences = sum(1 for sent in sentences if "?" in sent)
        rhetorical_score = sum(
            1
            for sent in sentences
            if "?" in sent
            and any(q in sent.lower() for q in ["why", "how", "when", "where"])
        )
        negation_count = sum(
            1
            for sent in sentences
            if any(
                n in sent.lower()
                for n in ["not", "no", "never", "none", "dont", "doesnt"]
            )
        )
        exclamation_sentences = sum(1 for sent in sentences if "!" in sent)

        if len(sentences) > 1:
            sent_lens = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
            avg_sent_len = np.mean(sent_lens)
            max_sent_len = max(sent_lens)
            sent_len_ratio = avg_sent_len / max(max_sent_len, 1)
        else:
            sent_len_ratio = 1.0
            avg_sent_len = len(sentences[0].split()) if sentences else 0

        modal_count = sum(
            1
            for sent in sentences
            if any(
                m in sent.lower()
                for m in ["must", "will", "should", "have", "can", "cant", "won't"]
            )
        )

        target_words = [
            "idiot",
            "stupid",
            "fool",
            "asshole",
            "fuck",
            "shit",
            "damn",
            "bitch",
            "ass",
            "retard",
        ]
        target_count = sum(1 for word in target_words if word.lower() in text.lower())
        target_per_sent = target_count / max(n_sentences, 1)

        # FIXED: Removed duplicate target_per_sent at the end
        features.append(
            [
                n_sentences,
                you_count,
                imperative_count,
                question_sentences,
                rhetorical_score,
                negation_count,
                exclamation_sentences,
                sent_len_ratio,
                avg_sent_len,
                modal_count,
                target_count,
                target_per_sent,
                you_count / max(n_sentences, 1),
                imperative_count / max(n_sentences, 1),
                question_sentences / max(n_sentences, 1),
                exclamation_sentences / max(n_sentences, 1),
                negation_count / max(n_sentences, 1),
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)

# Character features
def extract_char_features(texts):
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = str(text)
        if not text.strip():
            features.append([0.0] * 8)
            continue
        char_count = len(text)
        upper_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
        exclamation_count = text.count("!")
        question_count = text.count("?")
        features.append(
            [
                char_count / max(len(text.split()), 1),
                upper_count / max(char_count, 1),
                exclamation_count / max(char_count, 1),
                question_count / max(char_count, 1),
                len(re.findall(r"[A-Z]{2,}", text)),
                len(re.findall(r"!\{2,}", text)),
                len(re.findall(r"\?\{2,}", text)),
                sum(1 for w in text.split() if w.isupper()) / max(len(text.split()), 1),
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features)
